## Industry Experience

::: {.cv-entry title="Dataminr" position="Data Analyst, R&D" date="2022 – 2023"}
- Built ingests to exploit new data sources via APIs and web scraping
- Developed automated workflows for data extraction, transformation, and quality assurance in consultation with subject matter experts
- Built, maintained, and updated visualisation dashboards and tools to monitor data health
- Developed protocols to systematise processes for future work
:::

::: {.cv-entry position="Editor, Domain Expert" date="2021 – 2022"}
- Monitored streams of potentially newsworthy content from around the globe and alerted clients on breaking news
- Developed new techniques for discovering breaking news events using social media and other publicly available data
- Tracked misinformation related to COVID-19 and election integrity across multiple jurisdictions in a variety of languages
:::

## Software

::: {.cv-pubs}
**CodeBook Lab** (2026). Python package for benchmarking local LLM annotation pipelines against human labels across models, prompts and inference settings. [[PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/codebook-lab/) · [Docs](https://lorcanmclaren.com/codebook-lab/)]

**CodeBook Studio** (2026). Browser-based tool for codebook development, human annotation and adjudication, with export to CodeBook Lab. [[App](https://codebook.streamlit.app/) · [Docs](https://lorcanmclaren.com/codebook-lab/studio.html)]
:::
